title: Two Smiling Children by Flower Bush, 1950s Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
247B

My two oldest "angels". Well, they look angelic here.
description: A charming mid-century deckle-edged snapshot depicting two young siblings—a young boy with a crew cut and a girl with short curly hair—standing together in front of a large flowering shrub on a sunny summer day. Both are dressed in casual summer wear, including light t-shirts and shorts. The back is inscribed with an affectionate maternal or parental note playfully noting their 'angelic' appearance.
